where.if: AND (CONVERT(code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,code,name,enabled FROM supplier ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: WHERE (#{scope.admin} OR o.operator_id=#{scope.userId}) AND e.event_at >= #{query.startDate} AND e.event_at < DATE_ADD(#{query.endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)AND o.supplier_id=#{query.supplierId}AND (CONVERT(s.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) supplier_id,s.code supplier_code,s.name supplier_name,SUM(e.signed_qty) net_qty,SUM(e.signed_amount) net_amount,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status='IN_STOCK' AND o.reconcile_status='UNRECONCILED' AND e.event_type='PURCHASE' THEN o.id END) unreconciled_count,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status='IN_STOCK' AND o.reconcile_status='DIFFERENCE' AND e.event_type='PURCHASE' THEN o.id END) difference_count FROM v_purchase_event e JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=e.purchase_id JOIN supplier s ON s.id=o.supplier_id GROUP BY s.id,s.code,s.name ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM v_purchase_event e JOIN purchase_order o ON o.id=e.purchase_id JOIN supplier s ON s.id=o.supplier_id
